description: This Python source file defines a configuration class and utility methods for integrating ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech (TTS) API into a larger system. It maps OpenAI TTS specifications to ElevenLabs API calls, including parameter handling, environment validation, request building, and response processing. It also manages voice mappings and URL construction for API requests.
